work_card1_heading: You find out at the gate. This one tells you first.
work_card1_body: Access changes quietly and gets discovered at a gate. Six documented mandates — audit, research, ideation, specification, evaluation, iteration — converge on one concept: an append-only record where every change carries a reason and a next step. Then I built it.
work_card2_heading: The screenshot says paid. My app asks the bank.
work_card2_body: Yape receipts can be faked field by field — except one. I entered app development to build the merchant-side check that reads it: React, TypeScript, banking-grade security discipline, and a test protocol that proves the claim held.
work_card3_heading: The Airport Trilogy: Apps for Jorge Chavez International
work_card3_body: One airport, three positions. A passenger app I built for myself and tested with four people. A booking redesign written for the selection process that hired me. Then TUUA Transfer, live today, whose payment screens I designed and handed to engineering.
work_card4_heading: Nine repositories, in the order I learned them.
work_card4_body: The ladder from a first console application to this portfolio, one rung per course, each one linking to the repository it produced and naming the single thing it added.
capabilities_lede: The strategist who builds – Not a commodity coder.
cap_s1_body: I confirm feasibility, design the journey, and take it to production — so your decision becomes a shipped product, not a slide deck.
cap_s2_body: I set up tokens, blocks, and rules once, then deploy them smoothly across the firm — making sure your teams adopt and master them.
cap_s3_body: I craft tools to grow what your teams do — sharing AI builds and know-how that boost speed and the work value for all staff.

about_jr_esan_deg_body: Industrial and Commercial Engineering, specialized in Corporate Finance. Two years in Economics preceded it. The systems-and-process grounding under everything since. Qualifier carried: leading business school in Peru.

about_jr_hunt_body: Quality control across 35 EPC projects, holding contractor deliverables to quality and schedule standards. Qualifier carried: South America’s first natural gas liquefaction plant.
about_jr_centrum_body: Merit order 1, specialized in Strategic Consulting. Full-time across three continents.

about_jr_maas_body: The second exchange term. Full-time across three continents, finishing first in class.
about_jr_esan_lec_body: Calculus I, Creative Processes and other courses to more than 1,200 students, in person and remote.
about_jr_utec_body: 29 teams guided in UX Design and Evaluation across 11 project sections at three levels, generating Community of Practice environments. Qualifier carried: leading engineering university.
about_jr_hec_title: HEC Montréal — MicroMasters in UX Design and Evaluation
about_jr_hec_body: Prototyping, data analysis and management. The credential that turns a strategy background into a design-research one.
about_jr_limafly_body: A high-fidelity prototype of the full passenger journey: a centralized information hub to mitigate operational flight disruptions, with a gamified commercial layer, built on a scalable design system with visual tokens and components with variants. Presented as a value proposition inside the Lima Airport selection process.
about_jr_lap_title: Lima Airport Partners — Processes and Innovation Specialist
about_jr_lap_body: Designed, prototyped, evaluated and handed off the TUUA payment platform mockup for the new terminal, articulating planning across five central areas — Finance, Airport Operations, IT, Commercial, Reputation. In production, charging the fee to 130,000+ international transfer passengers a month. Measured portfolio progress across 12 Innovation projects using EVM, with preventive and corrective action alongside the Product Owners. Facilitated 3 agile workshops for 70 collaborators, rated 3.88/4. Qualifier carried: operator of Jorge Chávez Airport.
about_jr_single_body: Hand-written HTML/CSS/JS, a token-based visual system, ten reusable building blocks, a bilingual internationalization engine, WCAG AA. The direct ancestor of this site, kept public so the replacement can be checked against it. 32 active build-days inside a 73-day window — the start commit-sourced, 6 Jul the principal’s own account — and 52 pull requests, summed across both repositories.
about_jr_tv_body: A React and TypeScript application built in under a week so merchants can verify that a payment is genuine. Interface security controls including: a secure keypad with randomized digits, double-click prevention, private-data protection. 45/45 automated tests across 6 fraud scenarios and 5 CI checks. Originated in research on the digital-wallet payment-fraud landscape in Peru, plus a business case.
about_jr_accredita_body: A press-accreditation companion application for journalists, in the context of the 2026 World Cup. Blazor WebAssembly on .NET 10, an optional ASP.NET Core Web API, a TypeScript interop layer. 512 front-end and 33 back-end tests. Three languages at exact parity — EN/ES/PT. Real-time communication (SignalR/WebSockets). A full UX dossier in the repository. Architecturally it descends from EventEase, the earlier Blazor build. A portfolio demonstration: built, published, deployed, documented and audited — never delivered to a client and never in production. Its data is simulated and the application says so.
about_jr_apex_body: This site. The multipage portfolio the reader is standing inside, designed, built and governed end to end.
about_jr_bgs_body: Lifetime member of the international business honour society, inducted on academic merit through the CENTRUM PUCP Business School chapter on 14 November 2018.
